subject: Closure checklist: phased MAP, evaluation gating, signature window & Day 1 cadence
messages:
From: Samantha Rios <samantha.rios@kestrelanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@kestrelanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft and evaluation timeline

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for last week's demo. We've reviewed the draft MAP you shared in the meeting and added a couple of constraints on our side (security review slot and procurement calendar). I've attached a marked-up MAP (Kestrel_MAP_v7.xlsx) with our preferred acceptance criteria for the eval:

- Endpoint availability: 99.5% during business hours (PST)
- Latency P95 should be < 300ms for 512-token jobs
- Quality gate: pass 90% on the 120-case evaluation set (semantic match / rating >= 4)

We can start the formal evaluation next Monday, 2027-11-29, provided we lock down the evaluator account and ingestion spec this week. Procurement asked about the signature window — they prefer a one-week signing window with an agreed start date of 2027-12-06 to coordinate their SSO and training.

Can you confirm the signoff steps you need internally (approvals, legal, and who will route the DocuSign)? Also — is there a preferred stagger for onboarding (pilot -> ramp -> full)? Our ops team prefers a 2-week pilot before the wider rollout.

Best,
Samantha
Director, Data Products
Kestrel Analytics

Attachments: Kestrel_MAP_v7.xlsx
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Rios <samantha.rios@kestrelanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation timeline

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the clear asks and the annotated MAP. We're aligned on the evaluation targets and the proposed pilot cadence. A few notes from our side:

- Internal approvals: we need written acceptance from Sales (Ben), Legal (Laura) for the standard data handling addendum, and final signoff from me as the account lead. Typical internal routing is: Sales -> Legal -> Account Lead -> DocuSign.
- Signature routing: we will use DocuSign and plan to have the envelope prepared by Legal on 11/30 so the external window can open 12/01.
- Start date: we can target the 2027-12-06 Day 0 as you suggested but will flag a phased Day 1 pilot (12/06–12/20), followed by a staged ramp to full throughput by 2028-01-03.

I'm attaching an Eval checklist (EvalChecklist_v3.pdf) with the mapping of Kestrel's acceptance criteria to our test harness (pass/fail thresholds, test IDs). Please confirm the sample set and ingestion format by EOD 11/23 so we can provision the evaluator account and schedule the 11/29 kickoff.

Sincerely,
Irene Choi
Account Director, Redwood Inference

Attachments: EvalChecklist_v3.pdf
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@kestrelanalytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Samantha Rios <samantha.rios@kestrelanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-11-23T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation timeline

Irene / Samantha —

Quick confirmation from procurement: sample set will be delivered as a CSV (utf-8) with 120 rows; our security team requires a SOC2 evidence request be included in the MAP (we'll need to see SOC2 type II report and retention policy). We'll loop Legal once you send the DAA.

Also, we have an exec review on 11/30 — if the evaluation kicks off 11/29 we need a short preliminary readout by 12/07 for the execs. Is a summary report by then feasible?

Thanks,
Carlos
Sr. Procurement Manager
Kestrel Analytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-25T11:35:00-08:00
Subject: INTERNAL — approval request: signing window & discount cadence for Kestrel

Irene/Laura —

Context: Kestrel is requesting the one-week signing window and a phased pilot with Day 0 on 2027-12-06. They also signaled they may need a 10% first-year usage credit if procurement escalates. I recommend we approve the standard MAP, sign on DocuSign 12/01–12/07, and offer a performance-backed credit (5% upfront + 5% if they hit the eval quality gate).

Questions for Legal: can we prepare the envelope with the DAA attached on 11/30? Laura, can you confirm routing and whether we need Exec Sponsor signoff for the credit?

Marissa — can you draft a short kickoff SLT readout template for 12/07 in case the execs request it?

Thanks,
Ben
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Rios <samantha.rios@kestrelanalytics.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@kestrelanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Closure checklist: phased MAP, evaluation gating, signature window & Day 1 cadence

All —

Confirming internal approvals and next steps:

1) Legal has reviewed Kestrel_MAP_v7.xlsx and the DAA clauses. We'll produce the Signature_Routing_Slate.pdf and prepare the DocuSign envelope on 2027-11-30. Envelope will route to: Samantha (Kestrel) -> Carlos (Procurement) -> Irene (Account Lead) -> Ben (Sales Ops) -> Legal (final counterparty confirmation).

2) Credit: approved as structured — 5% conditional on passing the evaluation gate (90% pass on the 120-case set), 5% discretionary on reaching committed throughput by 2028-01-15. Exec Sponsor approval is not required for this level; Sales Ops to record in HubSpot.

3) Evidence requests: SOC2 Type II and retention policy requested. Samantha/Carlos: please upload to the shared secure folder or send to legal@redwood.com by 11/30 so we can attach the evidence addendum.

4) Reporting cadence: short preliminary readout available 12/07 (automated report + 15-minute sync). Full evaluation report by 12/14.

Irene — Ben — Marissa — Marissa, please attach the 12/07 readout template to the HubSpot deal and I will copy the signature routing instructions into the DocuSign envelope notes.

Irene: will prepare the final kickoff email to the Kestrel team once the envelope is staged.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Signature_Routing_Slate.pdf
